name: weighted digit sum check
mechanism: weight the digits of an identifier by position (doubling alternate digits and folding the result), sum, and require the total to be a multiple of the base, so single-digit errors and most adjacent transpositions change the sum

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Luhn algorithm' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Error detection and correction: a method of validating identification numbers
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Luhn mod N algorithm': extension of Luhn to non-numeric characters
